title: Sequential colimit derived cohomology has finite-stage representatives
statement: For a commutative ring A and a sequential diagram D of arbitrary cochain complexes of A-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], every element x of H^0(Q(colimit D)) is H^0(Q(colimit.ι D e))(z) for some natural number e and some element z of H^0(Q(D_e)). Colimits are those of complexes, computed degreewise [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Lemma 10.8.8, homology commutes with directed colimits; applied in Tag 08DD

proof.text: Use ModuleCat.AB5, shrunk to small indexing categories, and Functor.preservesHomologyOfExact to make the module colimit functor preserve homology. Regard a diagram of short complexes as a short complex of diagrams via ShortComplex.functorEquivalence. Evaluation and colimit mapHomologyIso give the natural colimit comparison; homologyMap_mapNatTrans proves its cocone equations.

Taking the three adjacent terms of a complex preserves colimits by HomologicalComplex.isColimitOfEval and the corresponding ShortComplex criterion. Compose with short-complex homology and transport along HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctorIso to obtain preservation of sequential colimits by complex homology.

Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep supplies a finite-stage cohomology element. Transport through DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors. Its naturality and inverse identity identify the resulting class with the image under H^0(Q(colimit.ι)). This is valid for unbounded complexes, the zero ring and the zero diagram.

from.place: Proper-flat support argument: finite representatives after taking H^0 of the Koszul Hom-complex colimit

lean.statement:
theorem sequentialColimit_derivedHomology_representative
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (D : ℕ ⥤ CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) :
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0
    ∀ x : H.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (colimit D)),
      ∃ (e : ℕ) (z : H.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (D.obj e))),
        H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.ι D e)) z = x
